hero.headline: COP31 talks go into overtime in Antalya
hero.summary: Negotiators work an extra day past the scheduled close as crews box up the venue, with no final agreement yet on fossil fuels or finance — and the draft text drops every mention of ending fossil fuels.

hero.headline: Russia's barrage hits Kyiv — and spills into Poland
hero.summary: Over 400 drones and 110 missiles hit Ukraine, killing at least nine and damaging three Kyiv bridges; two Russian missiles and a drone land in Poland.

hero.headline: Saudi Arabia downs three Houthi missiles at Riyadh
hero.summary: The coalition intercepts three ballistic missiles aimed at the capital, the second Houthi attack on Riyadh in days.

hero.headline: Magnitude 6.8 quake strikes Peru, felt in Lima
hero.summary: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake hits central Peru in the Andean region of Junin, sending residents in Lima onto the streets; no immediate reports of casualties or major damage.

hero.headline: Trump calls Putin 'my friend' at three-way summit
hero.summary: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen and agree a 'declaration toward peace', with talks on nuclear weapons.

stories.headline: EU approves €1bn more arms for Ukraine
stories.summary: The Council funds joint procurement of drones, air defence, ammunition and radar, to be delivered by end of 2027.

stories.headline: EU pays Ukraine a record €7.9bn in one go
stories.summary: The Commission disburses its largest-ever tranche of macro-financial aid under the Ukraine Facility.

stories.headline: UK to send 1,000 long-range drones to Kyiv
stories.summary: A £260m package announced in Berlin includes strike drones able to fly over 1,000km, plus maritime and surveillance drones.

stories.headline: Denmark expels Russian attaché over rapper plot
stories.summary: Intelligence says Moscow ordered a plot to kill rapper Kyivstoner; two Danes are charged with attempted murder.

stories.headline: UK and EU agree youth mobility deal
stories.summary: Up to 100,000 young people a year each way, aged 18–31, may live, work and study across the Channel for three years.

stories.headline: Amnesty: Spanish police used excessive force
stories.summary: Officers used batons, tear gas and rubber bullets at last week's housing strike, leaving 36 hurt, five in hospital.

stories.headline: 1,100 children killed or hurt in Ukraine in 2026
stories.summary: The UN counts more than 1,100 children killed or wounded this year, the highest toll in over three years.

stories.headline: Iraqi troops enter militia stronghold
stories.summary: Federal forces deploy in Jurf al-Sakhar under a deal to curb Kataib Hezbollah, accused of siphoning hundreds of millions in oil.

stories.headline: Houthi missile hit Riyadh's tallest tower
stories.summary: The capital's tallest skyscraper was struck on Thursday, days before three more missiles were intercepted.

stories.headline: Coalition downed a Houthi cruise missile
stories.summary: Saudi air defences destroyed a cruise missile aimed at Riyadh on Wednesday, the coalition said.

stories.headline: World court: Myanmar committed genocide
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice rules 9–6 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in 2017 and orders reparations — the first time in the court's 80-year history it has held a state responsible for genocide.

stories.headline: Mongolia's president quits, forcing early vote
stories.summary: Parliament accepts Khurelsukh Ukhnaa's resignation over corruption claims — a first for a sitting president.

stories.headline: Hitman plotter jailed for nearly 20 years
stories.summary: Nikhil Gupta gets 235 months in New York for a murder-for-hire plot against Sikh separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun.

stories.headline: US panel accuses India of purging Muslim voters
stories.summary: The religious-freedom commission says a voter-roll revision struck 130 million names and urges a 'country of particular concern' label.

stories.headline: Trump says he will meet Kim Jong-un
stories.summary: The president says a meeting with North Korea's leader is on the cards after his Asia trip, though no date was set.

stories.headline: Senate refuses to end the Iran war
stories.summary: Senators vote 51–48 to defeat a war-powers resolution that would have forced Trump to end hostilities or seek approval.

stories.headline: Argentina passes disability law, 71–0
stories.summary: The Senate unanimously approves a permanent law guaranteeing pensions at 70% of the minimum benefit and the right to work.

stories.headline: Lula recognises the land of ailing Chief Raoni
stories.summary: Brazil declares 362,000 hectares of Kapot Nhinore the permanent home of the Kayapo and Yudja peoples.

stories.headline: US sanctions biker gang and mafia over cartels
stories.summary: Treasury blacklists Australia's Comancheros and Italy's 'Ndrangheta for moving drugs and money for the Sinaloa and Jalisco cartels.

stories.headline: South Africa's murders fall — still 60 a day
stories.summary: Police record 5,590 murders in three months, down 3.5%, yet 60 people a day are still killed, including 581 women.

stories.headline: COP31 side deals send €10m to Africa energy
stories.summary: Italy and the UN agency pledge funds for biogas at Kenyan schools and digital power grids in Uganda.

stories.headline: US let nearly 900,000 AI chips go to China
stories.summary: Licensing records show 879,000 Nvidia and AMD chips approved for Chinese firms, including 150,000 for Tencent.

stories.headline: Potatoes grow in mock moon dirt
stories.summary: Oregon State shows potatoes complete their life cycle in simulated lunar soil mixed with 30% worm compost, matching Earth yields.

stories.headline: COP31 draft drops fossil-fuel phase-out
stories.summary: The Antalya text strips out any reference to ending fossil fuels and drops a $120bn adaptation finance goal.

stories.headline: Outages hit US email, banking and flights
stories.summary: A string of technical failures unsettles Americans as Trump flies to Asia, with people unable to reach email, banks or flights.

stories.headline: Next climate summit set for Ethiopia in 2027
stories.summary: Next year's climate summit is scheduled for Addis Ababa in November 2027, after COP31 in Antalya.

stories.headline: Trump pardons baseball's hit king Pete Rose
stories.summary: The late Pete Rose, banned for betting on games, receives a posthumous 'complete and total pardon' as Trump flies home from Asia.

stories.headline: Mali hit three past New Zealand at U-17 World Cup
stories.summary: Halidou Maiga scores a hat-trick as Mali beat New Zealand 3–0 in their opening Group G game at the FIFA U-17 World Cup.

stories.headline: Morocco rout Fiji 6–0 at U-17 World Cup
stories.summary: Morocco open their Group H campaign with a 6–0 win over Fiji, Ziyad Baha scoring twice including a penalty.

stories.headline: Late Bayliss strike rescues Auckland FC
stories.summary: Lachlan Bayliss scores in the 89th minute as Auckland FC draw 1–1 with Melbourne Victory in the A-League.

tagline: One page. The whole world. Every story verified against the outlet named.
